plan.title: Direct Single-Stage RFQ Award to Lowest Vendor and PO

steps.note: Open the direct single-stage event creation flow without using a purchase request.
Set the event type to RFQ and configure whole-lot awarding.

args.title: Direct Single Stage RFQ Award to L1

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template.
Verify that an RFQ template is applied.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10; exact variant selection is not expressible.
Verify that the create screen contains one line item.
Complete the pricing sheet after adding the line item.
Verify that the expected RFQ sheet columns rendered.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Invite two QA vendors so both Vendor A and Vendor B can submit bids.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Verify that the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor's quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify that the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's quote of 90 through a separate vendor session.
Verify that the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Close the bidding event before awarding.
Open Master QCS to compare the two vendor bids.
Verify that both vendor columns are present with real names.
Verify that the lower amount ranks better and that both bids are ranked.
Award the complete lot to the lowest bidder, which should be the vendor quoting 90.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Attempt proposal approval; the catalog supports approval only when the current buyer is the pending approver, not a separate approver identity.
Complete PO creation from the approved award.
Verify that one PO contains the awarded line item with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the event moved to History.
Open the History tab.
Verify that this plan's event appears in History.
Reopen the event to inspect its post-award actions.
Verify that Recreate Order remains available after award and PO creation.
